title: Optimize columnar analytics value preallocation
constraints: Preserve Arrow RecordBatch conversion and vectorized aggregate semantics
rationale: rows_to_record_batch builds one Arrow value vector per projected column and already knows the row count. Preallocating these value vectors avoids growth while converting row-oriented results into Arrow arrays.
steps: Replace iterator collect for Int64 column values with preallocated push
Replace iterator collect for Float64 column values with preallocated push
Replace iterator collect for Utf8 column values with preallocated push
Verify RecordBatch conversion and vectorized aggregate helpers
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn during columnar analytics batch construction without changing Arrow array contents.
